misconceptions.description: Submitting the working file format when the assignment requires a fixed or exported format
misconceptions.trigger: learner uploads a .pptx or .docx when a PDF was required, or shares an editable link instead of a published one
misconceptions.feedback: Read the format requirement. Export to the required type (often PDF for layout fidelity) and open the exported file once to confirm it looks right before submitting.

misconceptions.description: Submitting a GitHub Pages or shared-doc link without opening it in a fresh, signed-out browser
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes a link that works on their machine but is private or 404 to others
misconceptions.feedback: Test the link in an incognito or signed-out window. A page that loads for you may be private, a localhost address, or a 404 for the grader.

misconceptions.description: Naming the submission 'final.docx' or 'untitled' so it cannot be identified among many submissions
misconceptions.trigger: file is named 'final' or 'document1' with no name, course, or assignment
misconceptions.feedback: Use a clear convention like lastname_cat100_capstone.pdf. A meaningful, consistent name makes the file identifiable and avoids overwrite collisions.
